name: Zoho Cliq
one_liner: Zoho's collaboration and messaging app, with REST APIs, bots and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Zoho OAuth 2.0 authorization code via accounts.zoho.com with scopes like ZohoCliq.Channels.READ; access_type=offline for refresh tokens; per-data-center domains.
access_notes: A Free Cliq plan exists (pricing page; paid Standard US$18/month up to 25 users, Professional US$2/user/month, Enterprise US$4/user/month). Apps are registered self-serve in the Zoho API console. No documented API plan gating found; unverified.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve Zoho OAuth app registration, free plan, documented REST v2/v3 with per-endpoint quotas; per-data-center domains add minor complexity.

needs_human_reason: Plan-tier gating of API access not explicitly confirmed; webhook docs pages 404ed so webhooks (incoming webhooks / bot handlers) inferred; MCP URL not found.

evidence.quote: The quota limit for this API is 20 requests per minute per user
v2 remains fully supported alongside v3.

disputes.why: Free plan on pricing page plus self-serve console; no plan gating found for API.
Blocker was only missing info; free plan and self-serve OAuth found.
v2 docs list per-endpoint quota limits (e.g. 5 or 20 requests/min/user).
v2 docs show many resource families (users, channels, chats, messages); exact count unverified, v2 page truncated.
Cliq platform has bots/incoming webhook handlers; only bots intro page fetched, weak evidence.
